text:
To: The UK prime minister

I urge you to put pressure on the parts of Israel’s economy that profit from war and occupation – and ensure the UK is not assisting these illegal acts. This must include:

19,658 have signed. Can you help reach 25,000?

I am happy to receive emails about campaign updates, ways to get involved and how to support Global Justice Now's work with a donation. (You can unsubscribe at any time).

Without your consent we won’t be able to send you updates on the progress of our campaigns, urgent actions, local events, surveys to have your say, and other ways to be part of the movement for global justice.

Israel’s genocide in Gaza and regime of oppression across the occupied Palestinian territory are possible because countries like the UK have allowed it to act with impunity.

Targeted economic sanctions would put pressure on the parts of Israel’s economy that profit from war and occupation – the UK has a legal and moral duty to act.

History is on our side: campaigns for economic pressure helped end apartheid in South Africa. We must now do the same and act now to achieve justice and liberation for Palestinians.

Will you sign the petition to demand sanctions on Israel now?
